title: Eleusinian Mysteries and the kykeon
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Eleusinian Mysteries and the kykeon, about ancient Greece at Eleusis, 13 miles northwest of Athens, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: of they they drink the kekon which is maybe as speculated by Brian Morescu this sort of urgot that contains LSD
it could be the theian mysteries where they discovered this urgot preparation.
tellings.difference: Told by Gallimore rather than the host, and does not name the kykeon or LSD.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the Eleusinian Mysteries using an ergot preparation, as speculated by Brian Muraresku.

tellings.quote: people went to Elusus as human beings and from what little testimony survived, again, because it's secret, under penalty of death, they they walked away thinking they were immortal.
tellings.difference: Stresses that initiates came away believing they were immortal and that the rites were secret on pain of death, and does not mention the kykeon.
tellings.link_reason: The same Eleusinian Mysteries at Eleusis, credited to Brian Muraresku.

tellings.quote: some, you know, crazy psychedelic kekon in the Greek Elusinian mystery rituals back in the day,
tellings.difference: Frames the kykeon as a psychedelic that freed the soul so people could see beings, and doesn't mention Muraresku's ergot/LSD idea.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the kykeon drunk in the Eleusinian Mysteries at Eleusis as a mind-altering potion.

as_told.title: Eleusinian mysteries' kykeon used to free the soul and see beings

tellings.quote: this cathedral in Greece around the Elusinian mystery rituals, you had, you know, if you die before you die, you won't die when you die.
tellings.difference: Frames the mysteries by the saying 'die before you die' and leaves out the kykeon and ergot.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the Eleusinian mystery rituals and what initiates came away with. The story's tellings already include initiates leaving convinced they were immortal.

as_told.title: Eleusinian mysteries: die before you die
